subject: Request: KMS/HSM encryption evidence for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@finserve.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Encryption & KMS evidence needed for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Monica,

We're prepping for FinServe's SOC 2 readiness review next sprint and our external assessors asked for detailed evidence around encryption and key management. Can you provide the following artifacts by EOD Friday (Mar 6) if possible?

- High-level KMS architecture diagram showing where keys are stored and envelope encryption flow.
- Confirmation of HSM usage (CloudHSM or equivalent) and an inventory of HSM instances.
- Key rotation policy (automated/manual cadence, retention of previous key versions).
- Evidence of encryption in transit and at rest (config snippets, TLS profiles, storage encryption settings).
- Recent KMS audit/log excerpt showing key-create/key-rotate events (sanitized).

If you have a single package or a shared drive link that contains the items, that would speed things up — otherwise individual files are fine. Also let us know if any items are restricted (e.g., vendor-managed HSM inventory).

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Senior Compliance Manager
FinServe
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Encryption & KMS evidence needed for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Lauren & Rishi — forwarding FinServe's ask below. They need a compact evidence package (diagram + policies + logs + HSM inventory). Can we compile the artifacts and get them back to me by EOD Thu so I can review and send to Maria?

Action items:
- Rishi: please pull the KMS audit log excerpt and confirm automated rotation settings for Customer Master Keys (CMKs).
- Lauren: can you export the HSM inventory and update the diagram to show envelope encryption paths (app -> redis cache -> storage)?
- Dev: please check whether there are any redaction concerns for logs (IP addresses, user IDs) and sanitize as needed.

I'll assemble a cover note and include our SOC 2 report link if they want the full report. Let me know if you need extra time.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Encryption & KMS evidence needed for upcoming SOC 2 review

Monica / Lauren — quick status and answers inline.

- KMS provider: we use AWS KMS for CMKs and AWS CloudHSM for HSM-backed keys where FIPS-backed HSMs are required.
- Encryption at rest: all customer data volumes are encrypted with CMKs (AES-256 via KMS-managed keys). Storage buckets have server-side encryption (SSE-KMS).
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced for all external endpoints; internal service-to-service mTLS for sensitive traffic.
- Key rotation: automated rotation enabled for AWS-managed CMKs where supported (90-day rotation for service keys); customer-managed CMKs have rotation policy with 365-day cadence. We maintain previous key versions for 30 days for rollback.
- HSM inventory: attached CSV (hsm_inventory.csv) contains instance IDs, region, and purpose. Note: some CloudHSM clusters are vendor-managed for Dedicated deployments — marked in the CSV.
- Audit logs: I exported a sanitized excerpt showing key Create/Rotate/Disable events (kms_audit_log_excerpt.txt). IP addresses and IAM principals were redacted per policy.

Attachments: hsm_inventory.csv; kms_audit_log_excerpt.txt

If you want, I can also generate a short narrative that maps each item to SIG/CAIQ questions.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

- KMS_arch_diagram.pdf (envelope encryption flow + HSM mapping)
- key_rotation_policy_v1.docx (rotation cadences and retention)

Best,
Monica Patel
